Drug Candidates

Lead Therapeutic Candidates

Our leading candidates combine natural product science with structure-based drug design to deliver novel mechanisms of action.

PRC0028 — Lead Candidate

A first-in-class natural product-derived therapy targeting S100 proteins and key inflammatory signaling pathways. PRC0028 has demonstrated significant efficacy in completed and ongoing international registrational trials for plaque psoriasis.

Phase III — Plaque Psoriasis

BA01 — AMP Inhibitor

A next-generation antimicrobial peptide inhibitor designed to target the AMP signaling axis implicated in chronic autoimmune inflammatory disease. BA01 represents AlsysLife's novel approach to modulating innate immunity in skin disorders.

Phase I — AMP Inhibition
